sections.heading: Welcome to Alifu Dhaalu Atoll
paragraphs: Alifu Dhaalu Atoll, the southern part of Ari Atoll, is a diver's paradise renowned for its spectacular marine life and luxurious resorts. This central atoll offers some of the best opportunities in the Maldives to encounter whale sharks, manta rays, and vibrant coral reefs.

With its convenient location just west of Malé, Alifu Dhaalu combines easy accessibility with pristine natural beauty. The atoll features a mix of exclusive resort islands and traditional fishing villages, offering visitors both luxury and cultural experiences.

sections.heading: Exceptional Dive Sites in Alifu Dhaalu
paragraphs: One of the most reliable spots in the Maldives to encounter gentle whale sharks year-round.
Depth: 5-30m | Level: All levels | Season: Year-round

paragraphs: Swim alongside these gentle giants in their natural habitat with expert guides.
Evening boat trips to spot playful spinner dolphins against breathtaking sunsets.
Pamper yourself with luxurious treatments in overwater spa pavilions.

sections.heading: Visitor Experiences
paragraphs: Our stay at Mirihi Island Resort was absolute perfection! The house reef was incredible - we saw turtles, reef sharks, and countless colorful fish right from our villa. The whale shark snorkeling excursion was the highlight of our trip. The crew knew exactly where to find these gentle giants!

Alifu Dhaalu's diving is world-class. We did 10 dives and saw mantas at Manta Point on every dive! The visibility was excellent and marine life abundant. Constance Moofushi was luxurious but we wish there were more dining options. Would still highly recommend for divers!
